name: pop-visualizer
description: Timeline visualizer, editor and wave simulator for Team Fortress 2 Mann vs. Machine popfiles
author: ptyx

scripts.test: node test/roundtrip.mjs && node test/model.mjs && node test/hardening.mjs && node test/navkernel.mjs && node test/vtfkernel.mjs && node test/lzmakernel.mjs && node test/bakekernel.mjs && node test/mapentities.mjs && node test/interrupt.mjs && node test/wavegates.mjs && node test/separation.mjs && node test/truncation.mjs && node test/registry.mjs && node test/spawners.mjs && node test/traits.mjs && node test/events.mjs && node test/pointtemplates.mjs && node test/vmt.mjs && node test/gamefs.mjs && node test/navpick.mjs && node test/tonemap.mjs && node test/rafmod.mjs && node test/mapassets.mjs && node test/botanims.mjs
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node -e "for (const n of ['navkernel','vtfkernel','lzmakernel','bakekernel']) require('fs').copyFileSync(`rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/${n}.wasm`,`shared/${n}.wasm`)"

linux.synopsis: TF2 Mann vs. Machine popfile visualizer and editor
